description: This file defines a Note class used to represent notes, including their properties and behaviors such as creation, copying, serialization, and deserialization. It uses Hive annotations for local storage.

classes.name: Note
classes.description: A data model class representing a note with attributes like id, title, content, timestamps, and pinned status, along with methods for instantiation, copying, and serialization.

methods.name: Note.create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate a new Note with current timestamps and optional parameters.

methods.name: Note.copyWith
methods.description: Creates a copy of the current Note, optionally overriding specific fields.

methods.name: Note.toMap
methods.description: Serializes the Note instance into a Map suitable for storage or transmission.

methods.name: Note.fromMap
methods.description: Deserializes a Map into a Note instance, parsing dates and handling defaults.
